records.reason: Grants fast healing only to your knights (allies/kingdom NPCs); nothing on the caster's own sheet changes.
Reaction that gives allies cover and gives you a one-off weakness scaled to how many allies benefit, against a single triggering effect only — transient, table-resolved, not a persistent weakness.

Temporary polymorph that copies the Vapor Form spell (already a spell record); the form is transient and carries losses (no item AC bonus, can't attack) that no mode can express without over-granting.
Grants temporary Hit Points on a trigger; temp HP is entered transiently in the HP control and the 'once per 10 minutes' frequency has no matching limitedUses period.
The ally substitutes your save modifier for theirs — it changes only the ally's roll, never your sheet.
Sets Hardness/HP of the soul cage object and shortens an off-screen downtime rebuild timer; neither is a player statistic the app models.

Grants the Instant Recovery action and doubles rest recovery. Instant Recovery exists only in content.actions (no feat record), and grantsFeats resolves solely against content.feats (src/rules/build.ts ~2343), so the granted action can never reach the sheet; there is also no lane for scaling nightly rest recovery.
An activity combining Fly, an Interact and a bomb Strike with widened splash — resolved at the table, no persistent statistic.

Grants the Fortify Focus activity, which exists only as a content.actions record with no feat counterpart; grantsFeats only resolves ids in content.feats, so no legal field can surface it on the sheet.
Conditional one-off extra use of Drain Bonded Item that expires next turn; a situational resource refresh resolved at the table, not a tracked pool change.

Refocus refills the ENTIRE focus pool instead of 1 point. The sheet has a Refocus button hard-coded to restore 1 Focus Point (src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx ~990) and no field expresses a full-refill Refocus (focusPoolBonus would be an over-grant — the pool size is unchanged).
Self-inflicted HP loss to make one projectile deal extra void damage on a single Strike; entirely transient and resolved at the table.
Extends Boost Eidolon to your summoned creatures — it changes only summoned creatures' statistics.
An activity that forces a foe to move and deals damage on the foe's failed save; entirely target-side and table-resolved.

The action is explicitly usable once between daily preparations, and the feat carries no use tracker; limitedUses draws use pips for exactly this (src/rules/featUses.ts). The stupefied/save part is target-side and needs nothing.
An exemplar ikon whose immanence (crit on a 19 with that specific ikon) and transcendence apply only while the ikon is imbued; the ikon subsystem and the crit result are resolved at the table.
Spellshape that marks a target and gives you narrative tracking information about it; nothing on your sheet changes.
An action that Demoralizes enemies and restricts their frightened value — entirely target-side and table-resolved.
Compresses an Interact plus a Strike/finisher into one action; an activity resolved at the table with no statistic change.
Grants snare formulas and lets crafted snares use your spell DC / gain the magical trait — crafting-subsystem and target-side effects, not player statistics.
Reaction resolved by a Deception check against the attack DC; the outcome (staying at 1 HP, wounded increase) is applied at the table.
Grants an action whose damage, shape and save are resolved at the table against the higher of your existing class/spell DC; no player statistic changes.
Same action as the general-feat version — a table-resolved breath attack using DCs the sheet already computes.
Optionally upsizes Kobold Breath's dice and area in exchange for a one-hour lockout; both sides are table-resolved and the trade-off cannot be a static field.
Relaxes when you may Take Cover in difficult terrain — a positioning permission the GM adjudicates.
Makes the attacker off-guard — changes only the target's condition.

Permanently upgrades every successful Swim check to a critical success (plus not sinking). No field or registry expresses a degree-of-success upgrade — there is no such lane anywhere in src/rules — and situational only carries numeric bonuses, so writing one would misstate the rule.
Grants the Salt Wound reaction, which exists only as a content.actions record; grantsFeats resolves against content.feats only, so nothing can put this reaction on the sheet.
Changes the footprint and cost of quick-deployment snares — a snare-crafting/battlefield concern the app does not model.
Makes an enemy off-guard against you when flanked by named crewmates — target-side and dependent on table positioning.

Grants the Ultimatum of Liberation action, which exists only in content.actions with no feat counterpart, so no legal field can surface it. The mythic-proficiency Escape/Force Open option is a per-use Mythic Point spend and the anathema is GM-adjudicated.
Applies frightened to a target on your critical hit — target-side only.
Adds damage to a foe after a successful Athletics maneuver while raging; a damage rider on a non-Strike action, applied at the table.

Permanently adds an extra damage die on every melee critical hit plus persistent bleed equal to two dice. The strike pipeline models weapon damage but has no extra-crit-dice lane (no critDamage/critExtraDice anywhere in src), and situational only carries flat numeric bonuses, so the printed die cannot be stated correctly.
An action making an extra unarmed Strike that stupefies the target — target-side, resolved at the table.
A press activity whose extra weapon die and failure damage apply only to that one Strike; resolved at the table.
A press activity granting a free Shove and off-guard on the target; entirely target-side and table-resolved.
Sequences siege-weapon Launch/Load with a firearm Strike/reload; siege weaponry and action compression are resolved at the table.
An activity making two penalised Strikes that count once for MAP; the penalty applies only within the activity, not to the sheet's strike modifiers.
Raises the size limit for Shove/Trip targets — a restriction on the target's size that the app does not track.
An impulse whose sigil, penalties and damage all land on the target; nothing of the kineticist's own statistics changes.
An impulse granting a one-off long Stride/Leap; it is movement within the action, not a Speed change on the sheet.
Spellshape adding persistent fire damage to the spell's target; target-side and resolved when the spell is cast.
Reaction dealing damage to a triggering caster and adjacent creatures — entirely target-side.
Lets you converse with and use Diplomacy on burrowing animals, with the GM deciding which animals qualify; pure roleplay permission, no statistic.
Rebalances a light mortar's damage between creatures and objects — target/object-side and table-resolved.
Removes the penalty for making nonlethal Strikes with a butterfly sword; the app does not track the nonlethal-Strike penalty, and a +2 attack field would misstate it as a bonus.

Grants the Death Drone action, which exists only as a content.actions record with no feat counterpart, so grantsFeats cannot deliver it. (The fly Speed goes to the swarm, not the player, and needs nothing.)

The feat teaches the Cackle hex, and the hex exists as a focus spell record with id 'cackle', but no feat in the data lists it in focusSpells — so a witch taking this feat gets no hex on the Spells page.
Reaction giving resistance against one triggering attack and a save-based condition on the attacker; both are momentary and resolved at the table.
Optionally swaps a thrown bomb's splash damage for your Int modifier — a per-throw choice about damage dealt to targets.
Lets an ally spend an action to extend your composition; the benefit belongs to the ally and to spell duration tracking.
Reaction that removes an ally's dying condition and heals them — entirely ally-side.
Teleports your implement back to your hand; an item-retrieval action with no statistic change.
Lets you re-prepare a druid slot as a summon spell during 10 minutes of downtime; slot preparation is already a player choice in the app and the spells are on the druid list.
Makes your hunted prey off-guard to melee attacks and extends your sanctification to allies' Strikes — target-side and ally-side.
An impulse dealing area damage and forced movement to creatures in the area; entirely target-side.
Reaction to Stand without triggering reactions — a table-resolved action, no statistic.
Teleports your bonded item or spellbook to you; item retrieval only.
Adds a frighten-a-creature option to the Play to the Crowd benefit list — the effect lands on a target.
